note: Both sets capture the same core facts (grade level 0'-0", finished floor 2'-9 1/2", and 3/8" = 1'-0" scales), but Set B binds the elevations to the named sections (Section - East/West Module) and its quotes include both the finished floor and grade level lines, supporting the 'relative to grade level' condition. Set A adds several redundant and vaguer claims (e.g. 'building | grade level', 'West Module | grade level', and duplicate Grade Level/Finished Floor elevation entries) without adding new information. Neither set invents values, but Set B is more precise and less padded.
